reason: Build parses raw wire bytes directly via newRawFile, defaults missing syntax to proto2, and enforces no such required-field list.
BASE getDiffCves has no plus/minus parameters; it unconditionally merges new into updated. Agent described recalled upstream code as this implementation.
QLibraryInfo.version() reports the runtime Qt library version; the compile-time value is QT_VERSION_STR. Right API, wrong semantics.
The leading '2' is Qt's signal-signature prefix, present even on non-overloaded signals like signal1; it is not an overload index.
DiffPlus/DiffMinus are absent in BASE, but the agent had already added them with default-true flags; verifier ignored the agent's own edits.
In CUE an omitted optional field with a default stays absent; concreteness ignores defaults, so it does not become concrete.
utils.isNumber(null) is false because parseFloat(null) is NaN, so the guard rejects null after/uid rather than accepting them.
Actual annotation is Optional[Tuple[str, ...]]; the claim states only the tuple part, leaving out the implemented None case.
TestServeHTTP also asserts http.StatusOK besides a non-empty body; the 'only' claim leaves out the status check.
The required NewSource parameter is concrete *zap.Logger; a logger interface is a different type and cannot match that signature.
Network is needed only for uncached modules; the pinned modules are already in the module cache, but the claim is unconditional.
test/posts.js also calls apiPosts upvote, downvote, bookmark, unbookmark, get, getSummary, getIndex; 'only getRaw' omits them.
The orchestration function is earlyinit.early_init(args), not earlyinit.init(); the claim names a nonexistent function.
Get('sslmode')=='' also holds for an explicit empty '?sslmode='; it detects presence only for non-empty values, yet is presented generally.
The agent dated qutebrowser 1.8.1 to January 2019; the changelog shows release 2019-09-27. Right release, wrong date.
No UI call requests square art; album-detail 300px uses Fit preserving aspect ratio, so 'square 300' and square grid payloads are wrong.
A module-level 'from qutebrowser.utils import utils' cycle resolves fine since attributes are looked up at call time; claim misstates import behavior.
PyQt5 QVersionNumber.fromString returns a (QVersionNumber, suffixIndex) tuple; the code calls isNull on and returns the tuple.
Branch math is right, but the controller consumes start=20, computes stop=39, and never passes page, so the branch is bypassed.
Containers start only by default; with REDIS_HOST set tests use an external Redis, and short mode skips them entirely.
Baseline RedisCacheConfig and schema have no net_timeout entry; the agent recalled an upstream docs row that does not exist here.
getPrivateRoomId performs no uid validation; 'abc' reaches hasPrivateChat, which returns 0, yielding roomId null rather than an error.
isNumber is !isNaN(parseFloat(n)) && isFinite(n); it uses parseFloat and tests the original value, not parseInt.
The issue explicitly covers missing or invalid pagination; claim misreads the requirement as excluding malformed values like start:'foo'.
getPrivateRoomId passes uid unchanged; parseInt and the positive check apply only to the returned roomId.
The polyfill lacks bounds checking and integer conversion, so out-of-range negatives can read named properties instead of returning undefined.
protobuf-go maps struct fields by protobuf tags and offsets; no rule requires field counts to equal the descriptor's.
null converts to index 0, so at(null) returns the first element, not the value 0.
filetype.Build requires enums as the goTypes prefix before messages; appending the enum at the end shifts the mapping.
Postgres migration 1 drops a UNIQUE constraint directly, which CockroachDB rejects; wire compatibility does not extend to every migration.
Qt WebEngine 5.15 supports @exclude, @include, @match, @name, @run-at; @excludeMatch is not a recognized property.
filetype.Build pairs enumGoTypes[i] with descriptor enum i, so the enum's descriptor index must match its goTypes slot.
BASE shows only new and updated CVEs; previous-only resolved CVEs are never returned, so 'shows all differences' overstates scope.
The issue also requires a new utils.parse_version in utils.py; limiting scope to four modules leaves out that required work.
resizeImage returns nil early when the image is not larger than size, returning the original unsquared; mechanism omits that path.
The controller normalizes missing or nonnumeric pagination to start=0, stop=19 before the API, so an undefined check never fires.
DebugConsole.vue calls Api.post('/evaluate') and stores the response, so the UI does reference evaluation.
Qt fromString parses numeric segments and treats the remainder as a suffix, so '1.2.3-' is accepted as 1.2.3.
ReportCmd uses FillCveInfos and ResultWriter.Write; no report.Report function is called from subcmds in this revision.
GenFromURL preserves the input user, so the DSN is postgres://root@localhost:26257/defaultdb?sslmode=disable, not the user-less string.
